description: This Java class 'AutowiredDeviceConnectionAdapter' extends 'EventBusDeviceConnectionAdapter' and acts as a Spring Boot component that wires a 'DeviceConnectionService' instance into the adapter, enabling event bus-based device connection handling within the Hono device registry module.

classes.name: AutowiredDeviceConnectionAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that injects a DeviceConnectionService into the EventBusDeviceConnectionAdapter to facilitate device connection management in the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Setter method annotated with @Autowired and @Qualifier to inject a specific DeviceConnectionService implementation.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Overridden method to return the injected DeviceConnectionService instance.
